scope: Curated Anthropic-linked records and separately sourced October 29-30, 2026 vendor advisories; not exhaustive. Read-only assessments never install patches.

advisories.attribution: Named by Anthropic in its October 27 report
advisories.verification: Use cve98432.py inspect-source on exact built source AND check vendor advisory, installed binary package, reboot and uname -r. Source inspection alone never proves runtime repair.
advisories.limitations: Vendor backports and alternate kernel lifecycles vary; no automatic kernel version inference.

advisories.attribution: Named by Anthropic in its October 27 report
advisories.verification: Install latest applicable cumulative Windows update, restart, check actual OS build and UBR, and confirm product applicability in MSRC. The same major build 26100 exists on client and server with different fixed UBRs.
advisories.limitations: Unlisted builds/editions are not evaluated. The build evidence is for the MSRC affected editions, not a general Windows safety certificate.

advisories.attribution: Apple credits Milad Nasr and Nicholas Carlini with Claude, Anthropic
advisories.verification: Check About Safari/Apple OS version and official Apple security content for that specific release and device; apply Apple Software Update and restart.
advisories.limitations: Fixed release list is product-specific. A numeric comparison across macOS branches or older Safari-supported macOS versions is not automatically valid.

advisories.product: HashiCorp Nomad Community / Enterprise (allocation dispatch and executor logs)
advisories.verification: Identify Community vs Enterprise and exact branch on all Nomad clients; verify signed vendor release, upgraded running agents, and normal allocation dispatch; inspect all jobs that could plant symlinks.
advisories.limitations: Nomad 2.1.0 Community is NOT fixed. Do not compare Enterprise branch versions numerically or treat a service running on any OS as automatically affected. No live exploit-resistance testing.

advisories.product: HashiCorp Nomad Community / Enterprise (sticky ephemeral disk migration)
advisories.verification: Confirm affected Nomad clients updated in the correct edition/branch; run authorized replacement/migration tests with normal data and verify directory ownership remains expected.
advisories.limitations: Requires same-client allocation replacement and sticky ephemeral disk. A version claim alone does not test symlink escape resistance. CE 2.1.0 is NOT fixed.

advisories.attribution: Google Chrome Stable release; vendor critical severity (different from CISA ADP assessment)
advisories.verification: Update official desktop Chrome Stable from Google; relaunch; verify active build 156.0.8078.79 or later, vendor channel, platform and installation.
advisories.limitations: Do not infer any protection for Android, iOS, Chromium, Edge or another browser from this desktop release. Settings workarounds do not establish MediaStream exploit resistance.

advisories.product: Delinea Privilege Manager Windows Core Agent
advisories.attribution: Delinea security advisory and Privilege Manager release notes
advisories.verification: Inventory Core Agent version and product channel on each Windows endpoint; deploy vendor-provided branch-appropriate package and verify running agent build. Check effective inbound TCP 5593 policy and policy/revocation latency.
advisories.limitations: Vendor describes affected Windows agent builds and branch-specific fixed versions; macOS and Linux agent fixes cannot be inferred. Blocking 5593 changes on-prem push delivery to scheduled pulls.

advisories.product: ServiceNow AI Platform (hosted / partner / self-hosted service)
advisories.attribution: ServiceNow CNA record and official customer advisory KB3228994
advisories.verification: Verify instance branch, hot fix and maintenance record in ServiceNow; hosted customers confirm vendor deployment; self-hosted customers apply vendor-signed supported updates and verify the active instance build.
advisories.limitations: Service CVE, NOT an OS patch; Rhino sandbox risk cannot be fixed by host-only changes. Some branch mappings require authenticated vendor documentation, so automated status stays unknown.

advisories.product: Veeam Management Pack / Virtualization Extensions service
advisories.attribution: Veeam KB4961 and KB4949 (disclosed Oct 2026; CVE identifier reserved in 2023)
advisories.verification: Check affected Veeam Management Pack component and active build 13.1.0.334. Before upgrading confirm supported source version 9a build 9.1.0.3107 per KB4949; run SCOM/Collector smoke tests.
advisories.limitations: Only Veeam Management Pack for Microsoft System Center, not all Veeam products. Prior versions require supported upgrade sequencing; a version comparison is not an installer.

advisories.verification: Verify active Veeam Management Pack Collector build 13.1.0.334 after approved upgrade from supported source (9a build 9.1.0.3107); validate Collector service and SCOM operations.
advisories.limitations: Only Veeam Management Pack; does not certify other Veeam products. Upgrade from older 9.x may need staging to supported starting build.

unresolved.reason: Anthropic reports Google addressed it, but does not name CVEs or the required Android/Play services/firmware release. Do not misattribute unrelated Android bulletin CVEs.
unresolved.next_step: Obtain an official Google advisory mapping the chain to component, identifier, and fixed build.

unresolved.reason: Thousands of findings are not yet publicly identified or fixed. Hash-only entries cannot be converted into patches.
unresolved.next_step: Add individual findings only after maintainer disclosure and a verifiable fix are published.
